entities.summary: Carlos Augusto de Mascarenhas Relvas de Campos, more commonly known simply as Carlos Relvas, was a wealthy Portuguese landowner, and sportsman. He is perhaps best known as a talented amateur bullfighter, and as a pioneer of photography in Portugal.
